title: Titan Pro 15K Triple Berries Prefilled Pod + Refills
description: Triple Berries blends the rich taste of dark berries with bright, tangy notes for a balanced and satisfying vape. The mesh coil captures each fruit tone clearly, producing clean, steady flavour from start to finish. Each Titan Pro 15K Prefilled Pod pack includes a 2ml pod and 10ml refill container designed for the Titan Pro 15K device, offering extended use and dependable performance. How To Set Up Titan Pro 15K Pods Step 1 Insert the prefilled pod into the Titan Pro 15K device until it clicks. Step 2 Fit the 10ml refill container securely into the base compartment. Step 3 Inhale on the mouthpiece to vape. Replace both when empty. ✅ You're all set!
